run_healthcheck: run a healthcheck against the datasets-server endpoint and return connection status
create_dashboard_fetch: create a function that fetches trending datasets coverage stats and builder info from the datasets-server admin API
run_query_pending_jobs: run a DuckDB query against pending jobs data fetched from the datasets-server admin API
build_refresh_dataset: build a function that force-refreshes a dataset processing step with configurable priority and difficulty
draw_processing_graph: draw the processing graph as a matplotlib networkx visualization with configurable width and height
